Terms of use

Updated 20 November 2026

These terms cover the Mob web app, downloadable apps, browser extension and launch site. Mob provides tools for planning, focus sessions, and managing screen time.

Using Mob

Keep your account credentials secure. Use your own account and choose a username you’re allowed to use. Don’t impersonate other people, publish abusive content or interfere with other users or the service.

Your content

Your tasks, notes and settings remain yours. You allow Mob to store and process them as needed to provide the features you use. Score sharing is optional and can be turned off in Social. See the Privacy policy for data controls and account deletion.

Availability and limits

Features may change and sync can take time. Website and app limits depend on browser and device permissions. Keep a copy of important work and avoid relying on Mob as your only reminder for a critical deadline. Your rights under applicable consumer law still apply.

Third-party services and assets

Google sign-in and Spotify playback are subject to those providers’ terms. Metiq audio and other assets retain the terms of their own licenses. See Sound credits.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be raised through the Mob issue tracker.
